headline: Monster Beverage (MNST) Stock Looks Fully Priced Despite Strong Growth Hopes
summary: Monster Beverage stock has almost doubled over the past five years, yet the latest valuation work suggests the shares may now be trading at a premium to what its cash flows support. Despite solid recent returns and upbeat commentary around its growth prospects, both the intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach and the earnings multiples currently point to Monster Beverage looking expensive rather than cheap.
